# Galactic Stock Market compatibility - the Dividend Reinvestment card on GSM's regulation page.
# Buttons live in interface/zz_go_gsm_regulation.gui (generated by tools/gen_gsm_regulation.py).
# Scope (common/button_effects): This = selected object or player country, From = player country.
# Three stacked states per option, as GSM draws its own policies: current (solid), switch-to
# (ghost, clickable) and unavailable (off - the policy is on cooldown). Exactly one is visible.
# The policy, its options and their effects are defined in galactic_overhaul_gsm_drip_policy.txt;
# these buttons only call set_policy, exactly like the Policies screen.

# ---- go_drip_off
go_reg_drip_off_cur = {
	potential = { exists = from from = { go_drip_is_off = yes } }
	allow = { always = yes }
	effect = { custom_tooltip = GO_REG_DRIP_CURRENT_TT }
}
go_reg_drip_off_set = {
	potential = {
		exists = from
		from = {
			NOT = { go_drip_is_off = yes }
			can_change_policy = go_dividend_reinvestment
		}
	}
	allow = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = GO_REG_DRIP_SET_OFF_TT
		hidden_effect = {
			from = { set_policy = { policy = go_dividend_reinvestment option = go_drip_off cooldown = yes } }
		}
	}
}
go_reg_drip_off_no = {
	potential = {
		exists = from
		from = {
			NOT = { go_drip_is_off = yes }
			NOT = { can_change_policy = go_dividend_reinvestment }
		}
	}
	allow = { always = yes }
	effect = { custom_tooltip = GO_REG_DRIP_COOLDOWN_TT }
}

# ---- go_drip_on
go_reg_drip_on_cur = {
	potential = { exists = from from = { has_policy_flag = go_drip_active } }
	allow = { always = yes }
	effect = { custom_tooltip = GO_REG_DRIP_CURRENT_TT }
}
go_reg_drip_on_set = {
	potential = {
		exists = from
		from = {
			NOT = { has_policy_flag = go_drip_active }
			can_change_policy = go_dividend_reinvestment
		}
	}
	allow = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = GO_REG_DRIP_SET_ON_TT
		hidden_effect = {
			from = { set_policy = { policy = go_dividend_reinvestment option = go_drip_on cooldown = yes } }
		}
	}
}

		exists = from
		from = {
			NOT = { has_policy_flag = go_drip_active }
